def transform(grid):
    # Mark the extremal edge of the colored figure opposite the divider.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    div_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == 2 for x in grid[r])]
    div_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if div_rows:
        d = div_rows[0]
        occupied = [r for r in range(h) if r != d and any(x not in (2,3) for x in grid[r])]
        if occupied:
            edge = min(occupied) if max(occupied) < d else max(occupied)
            out[edge] = [8]*w
    elif div_cols:
        d = div_cols[0]
        occupied = [c for c in range(w) if c != d and any(grid[r][c] not in (2,3) for r in range(h))]
        if occupied:
            edge = min(occupied) if max(occupied) < d else max(occupied)
            for r in range(h): out[r][edge] = 8
    return out
